source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
While the only units an enemy unit is within **[Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** of are **FORTIFICATIONS** from your army:

- It can still be targeted by ranged attacks, but each such attack not made with a **[[PISTOL]](vsdata:weapon-ability/pistol)** takes -1 to its **[Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)**.
- If it [Falls Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) while **Battle-shocked**, its models skip **[Desperate Escape tests](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape)**, except any that are going to move across enemy models.
